subject.title: fix(gateway): add separate inline avatar size cap for agents.list projection

question: Should gateway agent projections omit avatars above 256 KiB while retaining them for storage and dedicated delivery, or should oversized avatars use thumbnails or lazy references?
rationale: The linked issue allows several durable designs, while silent omission changes existing user-visible behavior for avatar files that remain valid and stored.

options.title: Accept bounded omission
options.body: Use the 256 KiB wire limit for every inline avatar field and source, with clients falling back when larger avatars are omitted.

options.title: Require thumbnail or reference
options.body: Pause this patch and add a cached thumbnail or lazy avatar reference so large configured avatars remain visible without bloating `agents.list`.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded omission
recommendation.body: Use the 256 KiB wire limit for every inline avatar field and source, with clients falling back when larger avatars are omitted.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history assigns the resolver, gateway projection integration, and prior avatar payload hardening to this owner.
